pages.title: Classic Roblox Noob Waving on a Spawn Platform Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a classic Roblox Noob waving from a spawn platform, with a smiling face, blocky limbs, and pixel-shaped clouds overhead. A starburst pattern covers the platform beneath the character, while round treetops and square ground tiles add smaller sections around the broad body shapes on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Noob Dancing with Headphones Beside a Boombox Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox Noob dances beside a boombox in this printable coloring page, wearing large headphones with one arm raised and musical notes floating overhead. The tilted blocky pose, round speakers, and rectangular floor tiles give this coloring sheet a mix of large open spaces and smaller outlined details.

pages.title: Roblox Noob Driving a Go-kart Around a Race Track Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Roblox Noob driving a go-kart around a curved race track, with both hands on the wheel and checkered flags nearby. Broad tires and a low front bumper fill the foreground, while track barriers and sweeping motion lines frame the kart on this racing coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Noob Wearing a Spacesuit Beside a Rocket on the Moon Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Roblox Noob wearing a spacesuit beside a rocket on the moon, with a raised arm and Earth overhead. The helmet, chest controls, and knee panels add enclosed details to the character, while craters, scattered rocks, and stars surround the rocket on this space coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Noob Dressed as a Christmas Elf Carrying a Present Beside a Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, a Roblox Noob dressed as a Christmas elf carries a ribbon-wrapped present beside a decorated tree topped with a star. Pointed trim edges the hat and outfit, while round ornaments, looping garlands, and more gifts add smaller shapes around the blocky figure on this Christmas coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Noob Climbing Steps on a Giant Noob in an Obby Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Roblox Noob climbing steps on a giant Noob in an obby, with rectangular footholds stretching up the larger figure. The small climber reaches toward the next block as clouds surround the giant's head and limbs. Broad rectangular body sections leave plenty of open space on this coloring sheet.
